evidence.title: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes face cancellation, delays as war disrupts Russian shipments

occurrences.checkable_against: Black Sea port infrastructure condition reports and Russian shipping alternatives
occurrences.quote_span: "But there is no other option, as Black Sea infrastructure is crumbling because of the war."
occurrences.speaker: Sandeep Bajoria
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: Shipping schedules, freight contracts and voyage-duration records
occurrences.quote_span: "Shipping from Baltic ports means higher freight costs and an additional 10 days of voyage time," Bajoria, who is also CEO of Mumbai-based vegetable oil brokerage Sunvin Group, told Reuters.
occurrences.speaker: Sandeep Bajoria
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: October 2026 India sunflower oil import and shipment records
occurrences.quote_span: October shipments could fall to 160,000 tons due to delays in loading in Russia and Ukraine, said a New Delhi-based dealer.
occurrences.speaker: New Delhi-based dealer
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: Russian seller shipping plans and port loading records
occurrences.quote_span: Russian sellers are now seeking to ship sunflower oil from Baltic Sea ports such as St Petersburg and Ust-Luga as shipments from the Black Sea have become more difficult, the sources said.
occurrences.speaker: trade sources
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: Russian and Indian sunflower oil shipment and port records
occurrences.quote_span: A shipment of Russian sunflower oil bound for India was cancelled and other cargoes have been delayed after attacks on Black Sea ports disrupted exports from India's top supplier, an industry official and trade sources said.
occurrences.speaker: industry official and trade sources
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: Indonesia and Malaysia palm oil inventory data and Malaysian palm oil futures prices
occurrences.quote_span: Higher palm oil purchases by India could help draw down stocks in top producers Indonesia and Malaysia and support benchmark Malaysian palm oil futures .
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: India sunflower oil import statistics and customs records
occurrences.quote_span: India, which meets almost all of its sunflower oil demand through imports, needs about 250,000 tons of imports a month, but October shipments could fall to 160,000 tons due to delays in loading in Russia and Ukraine, said a New Delhi-based dealer.
occurrences.speaker: New Delhi-based dealer
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: Indian edible oil inventory and import records
occurrences.quote_span: Sunflower oil stocks have already been depleted due to below-average imports in recent months, and with demand for edible oils expected to rise during the upcoming festival season, India has been turning more to palm oil.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: Russian sunflower oil shipment contract and Black Sea port infrastructure records
occurrences.quote_span: A 20,000-ton shipment of Russian sunflower oil bound for India was "washed out" after the supplier was unable to deliver it because of damage to port infrastructure in the Black Sea region, Sandeep Bajoria, president of trade body the International Sunflower Oil Association, told Reuters.
occurrences.speaker: Sandeep Bajoria
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: Sunflower oil trade cancellation and washout records
occurrences.quote_span: Washouts, or cancellations, are rare in the sunflower oil trade, and have not been reported in many years.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: Sunflower oil shipment schedules and Indian palm oil purchase records
occurrences.quote_span: The Russia-Ukraine conflict has also delayed about 60,000 tons of sunflower oil bound for India, prompting Indian buyers to step up palm oil purchases ahead of the festival season, trade sources said.
occurrences.speaker: trade sources
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: Indian crude palm oil purchase contracts and import shipment records
occurrences.quote_span: India bought 150,000 tons of crude palm oil in just three days this week for November and December shipment for delivery to both the east and west coasts, the sources said.
occurrences.speaker: trade sources
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: India palm oil import statistics and customs records
occurrences.quote_span: It imported an average of about 632,000 tons of palm oil a month during the year to October 2025
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes

occurrences.checkable_against: Sunflower oil cargo shipping, cancellation and delivery records for India-bound shipments from Russia
occurrences.quote_span: EXCLUSIVE: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes face cancellation, delays as war disrupts Russian shipments
occurrences.speaker: Reuters
occurrences.subject: India-bound sunflower oil cargoes
